name: NTC 10K Thermistor Temperature Probe
description: Negative Temperature Coefficient ceramic semiconductor resistor whose resistance decreases predictably as temperature increases.
realWorldAnalogy: Negative Temperature Coefficient ceramic semiconductor resistor whose resistance decreases predictably as temperature increases.

pinout.description: Connected to Analog Pin A0 and 10k resistor to GND

hazards: Avoid placing sensor against open flame or surfaces above 100°C

wiringGuidance: Form a voltage divider: Connect one leg of the thermistor to 5V, the other leg to Arduino A0. Connect a 10k fixed resistor between A0 and GND.
commonMistakes: Connecting without a fixed 10k divider resistor—the analog pin will read constant 5V.
Assuming voltage changes linearly with temperature.

miniExperiment.title: Fingertip Heat Detector
miniExperiment.circuit: Thermistor between 5V and A0; 10k resistor between A0 and GND.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: ADC value decreases steadily as you pinch the thermistor bead with warm fingertips.
